```{r setup}
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r read, message = FALSE}
dat <- read_tsv(params$atac_rna_tsv)
```
```{r plot_corr_line}
cor_logfc <- cor.test(dat$log2FoldChange_atac, 
                      dat$log2FoldChange_rna,
                      method = "spearman") %>% 
  tidy()
lm_logfc <- dat %>% group_by(cluster_id) %>% 
  do(tidy(lm(log2FoldChange_rna ~ log2FoldChange_atac, .)))

min_max <- list(
  min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
  max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
)
abs_max <- dat %>% summarize(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), min_max)) %>% as.list() %>% unname() %>% unlist() %>% abs() %>% max()
corr_line_plot <- dat %>% 
    mutate(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), ~ round(., 2))) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange_atac, y = log2FoldChange_rna,
               color = cluster_id, text = gene_name, 
               group = as.factor(cluster_id))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'darkgrey') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'darkgrey') +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    #geom_smooth(method=lm, se=FALSE) +
    scale_color_viridis_d() +
    lims(x = c(-abs_max, abs_max), y = c(-abs_max, abs_max)) +
    labs(x = 'ATAC log2(FC)', y = 'RNA log2(FC)')
ggplotly(corr_line_plot)
```
